\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=4cm,height=4cm,axis lines=middle,
    xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1,enlargelimits=false,
    grid=major,grid style={dashed,gray!30},xlabel=$x$,ylabel=$y$]
    \addplot[blue,thick,domain=-1:1,samples=50] {x^3};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
